# Blockly Game

> > An interactive visual programming platform using Google Blockly to teach coding fundamentals through game-based challenges and puzzles.

Blockly Game provides a beginner-friendly environment for learning programming concepts like loops, variables, and logic using drag-and-drop block-based coding. Built on Google's Blockly framework, it offers educational games and challenges that compile to JavaScript, making it ideal for students and educators exploring visual programming concepts similar to Scratch and Code.org.

## Core Learning Games

- [Blockly Game - Blockly Online](https://www.blockly-game.com/): Homepage for Blockly Game visual block-based coding learning platform
- [Coding Game - Blockly online](https://www.blockly-game.com/programming.html): Interactive coding game teaching loops & variables with Blockly blocks
- [Maze Game - Blockly online](https://www.blockly-game.com/maze.html): Maze-based programming tutorial using Blockly visual coding blocks
- [Puzzle Challenge - Blockly Learning Platform](https://www.blockly-game.com/puzzle.html): Beginner puzzle challenge teaching block programming with JavaScript output
